title: Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Hollow bottom bracket axle spindle. This rationale is driven by hollow bottom bracket axle spindle and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for drivetrain hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g at 200W fiber laser
Go/No-Go ring gauging at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for hollow bottom bracket application
commonFailures: Fatigue failure at head tube junction - mitigated by smooth weld radius >=5mm + post-weld shot peening — critical for hollow bottom bracket performance

faq.q: What surface finishes are compatible with Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle for cycling use?
faq.a: Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle can be supplied with bead-blasted matte (Ra 1.6-3.2 µm), brushed satin, mirror polish, or PVD-colored finish. Bead-blasted + passivation is the standard for hollow bottom bracket as it provides the best balance of cosmetic consistency, corrosion resistance, and cost. Anodized colors (gold, blue, purple per ASTM B136) are available on request.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle?
faq.a: Each Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for hollow bottom bracket.

sceneDescription: Titanium Bottom Bracket Spindle is a lightweight hollow bottom bracket component engineered for Hollow bottom bracket axle spindle. Forged and CNC machined from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V, it achieves 40-45% weight savings versus steel while maintaining the fatigue life required for demanding cycling applications. Threaded interfaces are designed to prevent galling in outdoor environments.
